description:
Get MartechKit building, behaving and shipping on iOS 27, and prove it in one real app.

MTSDK-18 reports the visible symptom: MartechKit does not compile on iOS 27, due to a RevenueCat compilation failure. That bump on its own is probably a one-liner.

The reason this is an epic and not a one-line fix: martech-kit's main has had no commits since 2026-04-09. CI pins Xcode 26.4 and builds against an iPhone 17 simulator - that is iOS 26, and it is green. Nothing here has been validated against iOS 27, and in three dormant months the seven exactly-pinned vendor SDKs and the toolchain have drifted. The cost is not the fix. It is finding out what the dormancy did.

There are also 7 unmerged branches, all stale since April or May. The iOS 27 dependency bumps will conflict with them, and the largest - with-generated-code, 29 commits, last touched 2026-05-06 - is newer than main and appears to already implement MTSDK-35 and MTSDK-36. Whoever picks this up should look at what is on those branches before bumping anything, but deciding their fate is not this epic's job.

Scope: restore a green build, prove the SDK still behaves correctly on iOS 27, ship it, and validate it in AI Design. This epic does not reshape the SDK - parity belongs in MTSDK-25 and verification tooling in MTSDK-47.

Timing: iOS 27 reaches GA in September. Anything done before then is against a beta or RC, so 'green on iOS 27' means green against the seed available at the time, and it has to be re-confirmed at GA. Target end of September rather than end of August: the two candidate owners are committed elsewhere in August - Vlad to the verification harnesses (MTSDK-48/49/50/51) and Victor to closing MTSDK-25 - and a date nobody is working toward is not a date.

Acceptance criteria:
- MartechKit builds and tests green against the iOS 27 SDK in CI
- The MTSDK-10 journey (configure, consent, view_screen_splash, purchase) runs clean on iOS 27
- A MartechKit release is tagged with stated iOS 27 support
- AI Design (iOS) runs on that release against iOS 27
- Every vendor SDK behaviour change found on iOS 27 is filed, not absorbed silently
- Re-confirmed against the iOS 27 GA build, not only the beta it was developed against
